About the Role

Following our acquisition of Active Key, we are looking for a Product Manager to take end-to-end ownership of our medical and hygienic hardware portfolio. In your first year, you will establish portfolio coherence across multiple international channels and markets, defining what we sell and why, mastering our SKU strategy, and bridging German engineering with our commercial teams.

Key Responsibilities:

You will be part of our Product Management, working alongside your 4 colleagues, while reporting directly to our Head of Product Management. In this role, you will collaborate closely with our engineering, marketing, and commercial teams across Europe

• Portfolio Architecture & SKU Strategy: Establish clear segmentation and tiering across the medical portfolio, mapping what we sell and why for clinical users and buyers across four channels and more than a dozen markets. Own the market-by-market SKU matrix (layouts, connectivity, finishes, certifications).

• Product Master Data: Act as the single source of truth for all product data, technical specifications, product descriptions, attributes, and compliance documentation across internal functions and external channel partners.

• Lifecycle Governance: Run the portfolio review cadence to manage structured SKU rationalization, phase-in/phase-out timelines, end-of-life (EOL) decisions, and migration paths for existing customers.

• Engineering & Commercial Interface: Serve as the two-way bridge with our German engineering team: translating clinical market realities and customer needs into functional requirements, while bringing technical feasibility, costs, and manufacturing capabilities back to sales and marketing.

• Clinical Discovery & Healthcare Requirements (PRDs): Conduct fieldwork across hospitals and healthcare environments to observe infection control and workstation realities (shared terminals, mobile carts/WOWs, virtual desktops). Translate these user workflows, user needs, and compliance requirements into structured Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

• Commercial Ownership & Business Cases: Author and own the financial business cases for all portfolio updates and introductions, including market opportunity sizing, pricing logic, margin targets, and sales volume forecasts.

• Go-To-Market Alignment: Partner with the rest of the departments to ensure our product portfolio and value proposition are clearly articulated to channel partners and clinical customers.

What we are looking for:

• Hardware Product Management: Min. 3 years of product management experience managing physical products or hardware portfolios through their complete lifecycle, from concept and launch to phase-out.

• Portfolio & Variant Management: Practical experience managing variant-rich product lines across multiple B2B sales channels and international markets, including SKU rationalization, portfolio mapping, and master data accuracy.

• Healthcare or Clinical Context: Prior experience in medical devices, clinical IT, healthcare environments, or relevant B2B/public sector hardware is strongly preferred.

• Commercial & Financial Acumen: Strong business mindset with hands-on experience modeling business cases, analyzing product margins, and defining pricing structures.

• User Discovery & Workflow Analysis: Practical experience conducting field discovery, observing end-user friction in real environments, and synthesizing findings into functional requirements.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to build trust and work constructively with technical engineering teams while representing commercial realities.

• Languages & Travel: Fluent in English, with professional working proficiency in German as a strong advantage; open to international travel to our other offices & production sites (Germany and Asia), and clinical customer sites across key markets.

What We Offer:

• Direct Portfolio Ownership: End-to-end ownership of our medical and hygienic portfolio with direct visibility to leadership and a clear mandate to create operational impact.

• Professional Growth: The opportunity to build portfolio management craft within an evolving, international workplace health company.

• Central Location & Hybrid Setup: A modern office right by Vesterport Station in Vesterbro, with flexible work-from-home options.

• Benefits & Wellbeing: A strong pension scheme, gym allowance, and regular monthly team breakfasts every first Friday and Friday bars every other month.

The Recruitment Process

All applications will be reviewed and responded to on an ongoing basis. We expect to begin interviews in week 42, with interviews held on a rolling basis throughout the period. Employment start date is expected to be earliest 1 December or 1 January, depending on the notice period of the successful candidate.

What to Expect in the Recruitment Process

• Screening: A short phone call with our HR Manager (15–20 minutes)

• 1st interview: With the HR Manager and Hiring Manager (60 minutes)

• 2nd interview: With the HR Manager and Hiring Manager. You can also expect to meet our Product Manager for Active Key online via Teams during this interview.Ahead of this interview, we will ask you to prepare a case and complete a personality profile, which we will use during the interview (90 minutes)

• Skip-level interview: Teams call with the VP of Marketing (30-40 minutes)

• Job offer

About Contour

We are on a mission to make the world a healthier place to work. Headquartered in Copenhagen with 30 years in business, Contour designs and develops ergonomic workplace equipment. We invented the RollerMouse, and 9 out of 10 users report our products helped relieve their pain.

Following our acquisition of Active Key, we combine ergonomic design with specialized hygienic peripherals. We are actively expanding our portfolio and commercial presence across Europe and North America.

We are a team of around 110 people globally, large enough to have international reach, yet small enough that your work is visible, owned, and directly felt across the business.

All contact will be treated with confidentiality. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of their background and identity. Our inclusion policy applies to all employment practices within the organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Contour makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact our HR team at hr@contourdesign.com.

Or else stay updated with our latest news on LinkedIn or on our website.

Imagine working on Denmark's most critical systems, turning unique customer data into real value through applied machine learning. As our new Data Scientist, you will play a key role in analysing customer data and training models within our established product. Ready to make an impact?

The job

You will be responsible for generating value from customer data within our established product, which underpins national security and critical infrastructure domains. Our customers are classified and cannot be disclosed, so your work will take place in secure environments, often in collaboration with Product teams, security teams and onsite at customer locations. As this is a newly established position, you will have the opportunity to help shape this role as it grows.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Analysing and preparing customer data for use in our established product

• Training, evaluating and refining machine learning models on customer data

• Integrating models and data-driven features that generate measurable value

• Exploring customer data to identify new opportunities for value creation

• Collaborating with security teams to ensure compliance with national classifications and profiles

Joining the team

You will join an organisation where you will be associated with multiple teams, part of our NSI business unit. We develop and maintain military-grade solutions that support a nation's most critical systems. The organisation is highly collaborative, organised around Products that make a difference.

If you are located in Aarhus, we are open to discussing a hybrid arrangement, but you should expect regular presence in Copenhagen (6–8 days per month).

Your qualifications

We are looking for a data scientist with hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world data in production settings, who can work confidently in high-stakes, security-classified environments.

• Relevant technical education, Bachelor's or Master's, in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or equivalent experience

• Documented experience with applied machine learning on real-world data

• Some hands-on experience with data science and machine learning in production settings

• Strong knowledge of Python, machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow), SQL and data processing tools

• Fluent Danish and English skills

• A strong security mindset and ability to work in high-stakes environments

Alongside this, we value:

• A collaborative and proactive work style

• Comfortable working independently and navigating ambiguity, particularly as this is a newly established role

• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities

• Comfortable working onsite at customer environments when needed

Expect travel activity to our HQ in Aarhus and to customer sites, primarily in Copenhagen.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

jobs.occupation: Software Architect: Agentic AI & Java, SitaWare Insight
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building sophisticated AI agents that solve real world problems? Join our Agentic AI team within SitaWare Insight, designing multi-agent workflows in Java and Python that power critical decision-making and help our customers get the job done faster and safer.

The job

As Software Architect on this team, you will combine deep software architecture expertise in Java with strong LLM and AI engineering fundamentals to shape the technical foundation of our AI-driven solutions. You will define the technical vision and architectural strategy that enable our product, AI agents and multi-agent systems to scale, while also designing and implementing the software solutions that bring this vision to life.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Converting customer needs into robust software architectures for AI agents, multi-agent orchestration and RAG pipelines

• Designing and implementing AI agents, including tool definitions, action groups and knowledge base integrations

• Ensuring safe and predictable outcomes through human-in-the-loop design and guardrails, and building traceability and transparency into our AI-based solutions

• Writing production-grade Java code with full test coverage, structured logging and robust error handling

• Establishing and maintaining technology standards, and evaluating new technologies as they emerge

Joining the team

You will join a growing team within the SitaWare Insight program, close to 50 engineers, architects and testers across five Scrum teams, spanning Aarhus and Copenhagen. We are building a brand-new team around this role:

an architect, a data scientist, five to seven developers and a tester, working closely with our Product Manager and UX designer. Java is our primary backend language, and we also work in Python for our AI tooling, and we collaborate with researchers to give our LLMs geospatial situational awareness, the ability to understand tactical maps and follow events across an evolving timeline. If you enjoy figuring out how to make new AI capabilities work safely and reliably in a domain where the stakes are real, you will feel at home here.

Your Qualifications

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in a software architecture role, designing and specifying system structures, interfaces and dependencies

• Strong backend development experience in Java, and familiarity with frontend architectures such as Angular or similar

• Strong understanding of microservices architecture, message queues and system integration patterns

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, and a solid grasp of how these fit into system architecture and deployment strategy

• A proven track record of defining technical vision and architectural strategy that supports product scalability and evolution

• Solid software engineering practices, including testing, logging, observability and version control, along with the ability to establish technology standards across a team

For more senior profiles, we are also looking for:

• At least two to three years focused on LLM or AI systems, including architecting and overseeing the deployment of AI-powered applications in Java and Python

• Deep understanding of orchestration frameworks, RAG architectures, vector databases, embedding models, hybrid search and tool-use/function-calling patterns

• Experience designing multi-agent systems, including orchestration patterns such as routing, delegation, parallelisation and result aggregation

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks and metrics, such as relevance, faithfulness and hallucination detection, and how to build evaluation and observability into system architecture

You should expect around two to four weeks of travel per year, giving you the chance to collaborate across our Aarhus and Copenhagen teams.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Are you our new Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology?

AudienceProject is looking for a Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology for our Copenhagen office to support our continued growth.

—

Are you a quantitative researcher who enjoys working with data about people? And are you interested in how panels and surveys can make audience measurement more reliable? Then, we have an opportunity for a career in a fast-growing scale-up with 100+ employees that collaborates directly with companies such as Heineken, L’Oréal, LVMH, Omnicom Media, Publicis Media, WPP Media, Amazon, Google, Netflix, RTL and Warner Bros. Discovery.

AudienceProject is a leader in independent cross-media measurement, enabling advertisers, media owners and the industry to trust, prove, and improve advertising outcomes through a scalable SaaS platform.

Our platform provides advertisers with a unified view of campaign performance, enabling confident omnichannel investment decisions, and provides media owners with comparable, third-party validation to demonstrate the value of their inventory.

After more than 15 years of leading cross-media measurement, we are now looking for a motivated Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology to join our Data Science Research team.

Joining AudienceProject will give you a front-row seat in the rapidly evolving advertising industry and an opportunity to work within a respected business, delivering insights about audiences across the world's largest media channels to top-tier clients.

What you will do

You will join our Data Science Research pod, led by Jacob Daniel Kirstejn Hansen, and help turn panel and survey data into reliable audience measurement. Our panelists are recruited through several panel partners. They contribute passive measurement data through integrations and take part in surveys that help calibrate our models. You will work with 10 other data scientists and engineers, bringing together a range of academic and professional backgrounds.

Your focus will be quantitative analysis, panel quality and statistical methodology. You will use Python to investigate data and develop reproducible analyses, working closely with researchers and engineers to improve the inputs and methods behind our measurement.

We actively explore and apply AI in our internal work, production systems and products, combining experimentation with sound analytical judgement. You will help evaluate promising approaches with data scientists and developers and turn useful ideas into practical improvements.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Analyse panel composition and coverage across partners, identifying differences, gaps and potential sources of bias.

• Assess the completeness, consistency and plausibility of passive measurement data, and investigate unexpected changes.

• Design and analyse surveys that describe panelists and their behaviour and provide data for model calibration.

• Contribute to the development and evaluation of weighting, calibration, and statistical modelling approaches, testing how methodological choices affect audience estimates.

• Identify survey-response quality issues and assess the trade-off between stricter quality rules and retaining a representative sample.

• Clean, combine, and analyse panel and survey datasets in Python, with clear documentation of assumptions, methods and limitations.

• Work with panel-partner colleagues, data scientists, and engineers to turn findings into practical data-quality improvements and evaluate their effect.

Who you are

You combine strong quantitative skills with curiosity about how people are represented in data. You enjoy tracing an unexpected result back to its source, questioning assumptions and explaining what the evidence supports. Your background may be in statistics, quantitative social science, economics, psychology, data science or another relevant field.

You bring:

• Strong skills in quantitative analysis and applied statistics, including regression, sampling, uncertainty and model validation.

• Hands-on Python skills to clean, explore and analyse real-world data independently and make your work reproducible.

• An understanding of panels and surveys, including representativeness, selection bias, non-response and measurement error.

• A careful approach to data quality and the ability to judge how data issues affect an analysis or model.

• The ability to explain methods and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• A relevant quantitative education or equivalent applied research experience.

Useful additional experience includes weighting, calibration or passive behavioural data.

We value thoughtful analysis, openness to different perspectives and colleagues who share what they learn. You ask questions, test assumptions and explain your conclusions clearly.

What we offer

You will join a curious, collaborative and energetic environment where data scientists and developers share ideas and learn from one another. Different perspectives help us ask better questions and improve how we measure audiences.

Our social calendar offers plenty of opportunities to get to know colleagues, with activities you can choose to join. There is room to contribute your ideas, take on meaningful research questions and develop your skills with the support of colleagues.

• Competitive salary

• Pension scheme and health insurance

• Home internet paid

• Central Copenhagen office

• International environment

• Friendly, supportive and helpful colleagues

• Innovative and market-leading products and services

• Real-world panel and survey data, with research questions about quality, representativeness and uncertainty

• The opportunity to improve the statistical methods behind independent audience measurement

• Working directly with some of the most modern and successful companies of our time

Send us your application

We welcome different routes into data science. If this role interests you and you bring relevant quantitative and Python skills, we would like to hear from you.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Jacob Daniel Kirstejn Hansen at jacobh@audienceproject.com. Attention: applications and documents sent via email will not be considered.

We are only considering candidates who are already based in Copenhagen, as we are unable to offer relocation support for this position.

We will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please don’t hesitate to send your application sooner rather than later.

You can only apply once to this position via Linkedin, so make sure you attach the following information into one document:

• CV

• Cover letter

The deadline for applications is the 6th of November, 2026.

We look forward to receiving your application!

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our Communication Coordinator, you’ll help bring our Digital and Lifecycle Services portfolio to life for colleagues, partners, customers, and end users around the world.

You’ll join the Digital & Lifecycle Services Communications team and contribute to strengthening the visibility of our service business through engaging visual communication, content, marketing materials, and events. Working across an international organization, you’ll have the opportunity to turn complex topics into clear and compelling communication.

This fixed-term role is available for one year and offers the opportunity to build hands-on experience across graphic design, communication, and service product launches in a global environment while contributing to solutions that support energy efficiency throughout the product lifecycle.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Work together with the Communication Manager to support daily internal and external communication activities, build content for thought leadership topics, and help with creation of focus business marketing narratives.

• Create engaging visual communication, including icons, visual concepts, posters, images, and other branded materials using Adobe tools.

• Develop content supporting marketing and communication activities across Digital & Lifecycle Services.

• Collaborate with global marketing teams to create and launch marketing materials such as sales presentations, fact sheets, product descriptions, and other communication assets.

• Contribute to our Service Partner Program, developing branded materials such as presentations, guides, fact sheets, visuals, and other supporting content.

**What We're Looking For

**We’re looking for someone who combines creativity with a structured approach and enjoys turning ideas into communication that is easy to understand and visually engaging.

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Bring

**

• Experience with graphic design, content creation, communication, or marketing and familiarity with design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign, video editing skillset, or similar.

• A structured, hands-on approach and the ability to coordinate tasks and projects involving different stakeholders

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a matrix organization with international and cross-functional environment.

• Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

• Relevant education in communication, marketing, business, design, or a related field.

Experience with B2B marketing, business consultancy, campaigns, agency work, or service-related businesses would be an advantage, but it is not essential. Most importantly, you are curious, collaborative, and motivated to create communication that makes an impact.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

In this role, you’ll gain broad experience across visual communication, content creation, global marketing collaboration, and events, while working with colleagues and stakeholders across an international organization.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you’re excited about combining creativity, communication, and collaboration to help make complex solutions clear and engaging, we’d love to hear from you.

You don’t need to meet every preferred qualification to apply. If this opportunity interests you and you believe your experience and perspective could add value to the team, we encourage you to apply.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Would you like to shape the employee experience for more than 1,500 colleagues in Denmark while helping position Coloplast as an employer of choice for future talent?

You will play a key role in connecting people, ideas and projects across the business, translating needs into practical solutions that create value for employees and leaders alike.

jobs.occupation: Lead Robotics/Drone Software & Computer Vision Engineer for TRDP ApS
jobs.description:
TRDP is a Danish defence-tech startup developing autonomous interceptor drone systems.

We are a small, hands-on team of 10 engineers and specialists working across robotics, software, electronics, mechanical engineering, drone building and flight testing.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who combines hands-on software development, computer vision, AI and systems architecture with the ability to guide a small engineering team.

Our software team currently consists of three robotics engineers with experience in mobile robotics, drones and visual odometry.

Your responsibilities

• 
Take an active role in software development, integration and testing.

• 
Contribute to computer vision, AI-based perception, object detection, tracking and sensor fusion.

• 
Design and maintain the overall software architecture.

• 
Coordinate and prioritise development tasks within the software team.

• 
Integrate software, sensors, electronics and control systems.

• 
Translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions.

• 
Work closely with our electronics, mechanical engineering and flight-testing teams.

Your background

• 
Degree in robotics, software engineering, computer science or a related field.

• 
Strong practical experience with robotics software and complex system integration.

• 
Solid knowledge of computer vision, AI and sensor fusion.

• 
Experience with software architecture and embedded systems.

• 
Ability to guide other engineers while contributing directly to development.

• 
Experience with C++, Python, ROS 2, PX4/ArduPilot or similar technologies is an advantage.

Who you are

You are a hands-on engineer with a strong understanding of complete robotic systems.

We’re looking for a Product Engineer to help us build better tools for legal research. You’ll work mainly on the backend, with a say in what we build and responsibility for taking it from an early idea to something customers use every day. That includes asking whether we’re solving the right problem, deciding what’s worth shipping first, and knowing when something needs more time.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

**What We Value

**“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Mess Around. Find Out. Share What You Learned.

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

You enjoy working through a product problem while it’s still taking shape. You ask questions, share unfinished work, and help decide what’s worth building. You’re comfortable taking a feature from those early conversations through implementation, testing, and delivery.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

Experience within food and organic-regenerative agriculture is an advantage, but not a prerequisite. Commitment to transforming the food system towards a more regenerative and resilient future is essential.

The right candidate

You are an experienced leader with a strong understanding of investments and of how capital can contribute to systemic change.

You combine sound judgement and the ability to create momentum with curiosity, collaboration and humility. You enjoy working in a small organisation where people remain close to the work and are motivated by long-term development.

__________________________________________________________________________

Location

Our office is at an organic farm in Humlebæk.

Timeline and application

Please apply before November 6th, 2026. Applications should be sent to Annette Hartvig Bohé at ahb@planetary.dk . Applications will be evaluated on an ongoing basis.

Questions

If you have questions about the job, feel free to reach out to Chair Jacob Jelsing, jj@planetary.dk, or Director Annette Hartvig Bohé, ahb@planetary.dk

Our guiding principles

Stay humble: Seeking to understand and improve the conditions for life on the planet is a task of infinite complexity. Grounded by nature, we stay humble and sincere in everything we do.

Learn with nature: Inspiration in nature and its biological processes will guide our investments. We shall adapt ourselves to nature, rather than forcing nature to comply with us.

Perceive wealth holistically: True wealth is much more than money in the bank. We perceive wealth as well-being and harmony between humans, nature and the economy.

Trust patient capital: Real value takes time to manifest. We support long-term business models and real value creation over quick profit maximisation.

Build strong communities: Strong communities build resilience and awareness. We strive to create movement and stronger connections within the networks we grow with.

Advocate for change: Real change depends on systemic change. We dedicate ourselves to create real, tangible change and assume leadership towards a new paradigm.

**Finance Business Partner, VELUX A/S - Østbirk

****Do you enjoy turning data into meaningful insights and working closely with people to influence decisions and drive performance? With a passion for business partnering and a strong analytical mindset, you could be our next Finance Business Partner in Østbirk.

****Meet your future team

**As part of our Global Finance team, you will join a group of dedicated and experienced colleagues supporting our production sites in Østbirk and Brædstrup. Together, we work to bring financial insights to life and enable informed business decisions that create value across the organisation.

In this role, you will work closely with operational leaders, managers, and finance stakeholders, building trusted relationships and gaining a deep understanding of our manufacturing business. We value collaboration, knowledge sharing, openness, and continuous learning, creating an environment where everyone can contribute and develop their skills.

**What We Offer

**As Finance Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting business performance and helping operational teams make data-driven decisions. You will have the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment where your expertise and insights contribute directly to business success.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Partner with managers and operational teams to provide financial insights and decision support.

• Monitor and analyse efficiency, production performance, material consumption, budgets, and key operational KPIs.

• Prepare financial analyses, business cases, and presentations to support strategic and operational decision-making.

• Support budgeting, forecasting, and monthly reporting processes.

• Contribute to standard costing and product costing activities within a manufacturing environment.

• Develop and enhance reports and dashboards using Excel and Power BI.

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, efficiencies, and value creation.

• Communicate financial information clearly and effectively to stakeholders across different functions and levels.

**What You Will Bring

**We are looking for a collaborative and curious finance professional who enjoys combining analytical thinking with strong business understanding. Whether your background is in Finance Business Partnering, Controlling, Financial Analysis, or a related field, you are motivated by creating value through insights and strong stakeholder relationships.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.

• Have strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into meaningful business insights.

• Build positive and productive relationships with stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• Have advanced Excel capabilities and an interest in reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI.

• Communicate fluently in both Danish and English.

• Work in a structured and organised manner while remaining flexible and solution-oriented.

• Thrive in a collaborative environment where teamwork and knowledge sharing are highly valued.

• Bring experience with SAP, standard costing, or product costing, although this is considered an advantage rather than a requirement.

If you do not meet every requirement but believe your experience and potential make you a strong candidate, we encourage you to apply. We recognise that diverse experiences and perspectives strengthen our teams and contribute to better outcomes.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof to transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees, and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

jobs.occupation: Regulatory Affairs Manager (Denmark) - Nordic Marketing Company
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape patient access across the Nordics by turning science into approved, available medicines? Do you thrive in complexity, navigating multiple indications and evolving legislation to find clear paths to approval? _Then this could be your next step with us at AstraZeneca!

_Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. This is an area where you are free to grow - you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways of working and exercise your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

**Introduction To Role

**In this Denmark-based role covering all Nordic countries, you will drive timely management of regulatory submissions and approvals, successful launches, and seamless lifecycle management to facilitate earlier access and safer use of our medicines. You will act as the regulatory affairs voice within brand and franchise teams, partnering closely with Market Access, Medical, Logistics, and others to connect regulatory strategy to real-world outcomes for patients and the business.

You will collaborate with European and global regulatory colleagues to influence plans with local insights, while being empowered to work independently and make decisions at pace to align science, policy, and patient need.

**Accountabilities

**

• Regulatory Strategy and Execution: Lead regulatory activities across launched products and pipeline assets to secure rapid, high-quality approvals and timely patient access.

• Intelligence and Foresight: Monitor changes in legislation and competitive activity to turn insights into advice, risk mitigation, and opportunities that shape plans and timelines.

• Authority Engagement: Build and maintain productive relationships with national health authorities; manage communications on pending issues and evolving requirements to de-risk regulatory approvals.

• Global Collaboration: Keep European and global regulatory teams current on local requirements and external dynamics; influence global strategies with Nordic perspectives.

• Compliance and Quality: Ensure labelling and compendial texts meet external requirements and AstraZeneca policies.

• Team Contribution: Drive ways-of-working improvements, contribute to department development, and share best practices that raise team effectiveness.

**Essential Skills/Experience

**

• Master's degree in Pharmacy or equivalent.

• Demonstrated experience with regulatory work.

• Experience from pharmaceutical development or manufacturing.

• Experience from working with health authorities.

• Excellent knowledge of English and at least one of the Nordic languages.

• Good knowledge of relevant legislation requirements and procedures.

• Solid business acumen and a good regulatory affairs toolbox to apply.

• Good at influencing and building relationships with senior and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Ability to plan, communicate and drive processes and projects all the way to the finish line.

**I&D

**We are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration. Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives - and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

**Why AstraZeneca?

**When we at AstraZeneca see every opportunity, no matter how small, as the beginning of something big. We are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration. Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives and are made to feel valued, energised and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

We strive to unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

**So, what is next?

**Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Great, because we cannot wait to hear from you!

Welcome with your application, in English, **latest by the 4th of November 2026!

**_Applications will be reviewed continuously throughout the application period.

_**Where can I find out more?**Follow AstraZeneca on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/1603/Inclusion & Diversity: Inclusion and diversityCareer site: https://careers.astrazeneca.com/Denmark: AstraZeneca Denmark

**Date Posted

**21-okt.-2026

**Closing Date

**04-nov.-2026

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

We have an exciting opportunity for a seasoned Logistics Procurement Category Manager to join the Group Procurement function at Royal Unibrew.

Are you a passionate procurement and supply chain professional with expertise in Logistics and a demonstrated track record of positively influencing across internal and external ecosystems to unlock end to end value and efficiencies to fuel sustainable growth?

As Group Category Manager – Logistics, you will report to the CPO and lead the development and execution of the Group Logistics procurement strategy across road freight including line-haul and last mile distribution, ocean freight, warehousing and related logistics services including pallets. You will combine strategic category leadership with hands-on execution, working closely with local market organisations,

The role will be based at our HQ in Faxe, Denmark.

**Main Responsibilities

**Strategy Development:

• Define and execute a multi-year procurement category strategy for Logistics that balances local execution with strategic priorities to support the group’s overarching goals.

• Leverage a strong external radar and category expertise to identify, evaluate and act on emerging opportunities and risks, i.e. external supplier landscape, commodities, industry best practices, digitalisation and automation and EU legislative environment.

**Category And Supplier Relationship Management

**

• Optimise category management processes, elevate sourcing and contract management processes, and build best practices with the market teams and stakeholders. Increase utilisation of eSourcing and development of digital tools to support cost modelling, benchmarking, and contract management.

• Develop supplier collaboration platforms with key suppliers across the group to unlock operational efficiencies, process enhancements, digital innovation, and to accelerate sustainability and circularity initiatives.

**Value Delivery, Efficiency And Business Partnering

**

• Deliver cost savings, supply chain efficiencies and carbon reduction targets. Establish ways of working with stakeholders to measure relevant KPIs, track initiatives, manage risk and deliver multiyear productivity plans.

• Ensure early engagement and alignment with relevant stakeholders on business strategy to maintain a fit for purpose and efficient logistics network driving optimal cost to serve to fuel sustainable business growth.

• Provide category leadership and inputs into on strategic projects, integration, and network optimisation.

• Streamline processes and drive digitalisation agenda.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Bachelor’s degree. Professional CIPS qualification or similar will be considered.

• Min. 8 years of relevant procurement experience in logistics categories in an international or matrixed organisation. Nordics and CPG industry experience is a plus.

• Comprehensive knowledge of procurement processes, ERP systems, procurement tools and network modelling, including a strong data analytics skillset and commodity management experience.

• Excellent communication, gravitas and influencing skills to build relationships with senior stakeholders internally and externally.

• Team player with a service-oriented mindset but is also not afraid to challenge the status quo or be the critical friend when required.

• Project and change management - track record for initiating and embedding change.

• Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands on execution.

• Energised by challenges, white spaces, and complexity.

• Enthusiastic, solution-oriented approach.

• Passion for developing and coaching teams.

**What Success Looks Like

**Success in this role means creating a Logistics procurement organisation that is recognised as a strategic business partner, delivering measurable value beyond price reduction.

The successful candidate will establish strong Group category governance while enabling local ownership, build strategic supplier partnerships, increase data and digital maturity, strengthen resilience and sustainability, and continuously identify opportunities to improve the total cost, service and efficiency of Royal Unibrew's logistics network.

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

Royal Unibrew produces, markets, sells, and distributes quality beverages. We are a consortium of more than 35 breweries and beverage producers from across Denmark, known especially for our traditional, locally-rooted brands such as Faxe Kondi, Egekilde, Royal Beer, Ceres, and Odense Pilsner, as well as partner brands like Pepsi MAX and Heineken.

Today, we are the second-largest beverage company in Denmark. Our journey began in 1856, and we still maintain a strong commercial focus, a clear growth strategy, and an ambitious sustainability strategy - both domestically and internationally.

You'll have over 1500 colleagues in Denmark and more than 2700 colleagues outside the country, including in Finland, Italy, France, Norway, Canada, the Netherlands, and the Baltic countries.

With us, you'll be part of challenging the boundaries of sustainable production and distribution. You'll help ensure a diverse range of beverages that bring people together - on the dance floor, during the third half, or over a meal - all while contributing to strengthening Danish sports, music, and community life.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager, EndoIntelligence Solutions, Global R&D
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Project Manager with a background in medical device development? Do you enjoy leading complex development projects and coordinating work across internal teams and external development partners? Then you may be the Project Manager we are looking for in EndoIntelligence Solutions within Global R&D.

In this role, you will lead a strategically important development project and work closely with a global and cross-functional team to ensure successful project execution from planning through delivery.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Project Manager, you will:

• Lead a cross-functional development project through all phases of the product development process.

• Drive project planning, execution, follow-up, and reporting of scope, timeline, budget, risks, and key decisions.

• Coordinate activities across engineering disciplines and key stakeholders.

• Manage and maintain strong collaboration with external development partners and suppliers.

• Facilitate project governance activities, including Steering Committee reviews and decision-making forums.

• Ensure project documentation and deliverables are completed in accordance with Ambu's quality system and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Create transparency, alignment, and engagement across the project team and stakeholder landscape.

• Support the continuous improvement of project management practices and lessons learned.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the perfect candidate cannot be defined on paper. However, you are likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Hold a technical degree within engineering or a related field.

• Have experience leading the development of complex medical device hardware, including electronics, mechanics, embedded systems, and integration across disciplines.

• Have worked closely with external development partners and suppliers and understand how to manage outsourced development activities, technical deliverables, timelines, and risks.

• Have experience working with internal and external development teams across different regions, including Asian and European countries, and bring the cultural awareness needed to adapt ways of working and build effective collaboration across cultures.

• Are comfortable navigating a complex stakeholder environment and driving alignment across functions.

• Bring a structured and proactive approach to project execution and risk management.

• Have strong communication and leadership skills and enjoy working with international teams.

• Are fluent in written and spoken English.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**At Ambu, you will become part of an international organization with ambitious growth plans and a strong innovation agenda. We work in cross-functional teams and value collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to contribute to innovative healthcare solutions while developing your professional and personal capabilities in a dynamic environment.

Apply directly through our job portal. We review applications on an ongoing basis.
